quote: They showed me four ovals in daylight by the window and told me which one they would pick and why. No pressure, just people who clearly know stones.
name: Theo R.

quote: I watched Teodor set the stone. That ten minutes was the moment I stopped worrying about buying something this expensive.
name: Rachel K.

quote: Every update came from Priya directly, with photos. I knew exactly where my ring was each week.
name: Marcus O.
